name: What is the best type of tile for bathroom floors and shower walls?

mainEntity.name: What is the best type of tile for bathroom floors and shower walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain and ceramic are the most practical choices for standard bathroom installations, while natural marble offers an upscale, custom appearance. Porcelain is denser and absorbs less water than standard ceramic, making it ideal for shower stalls and wet areas. Marble adds distinctive luxury and natural veining, but it requires periodic sealing to guard against moisture, shampoo stains, and cleaning agents. For bathroom floors, look for a textured matte or honed finish to improve traction underfoot. As a finish contractor specializing in tile and marble work, HH Remodeling helps you match the right material to your specific bathroom layout and maintenance preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain is best for durability and water resistance, while natural marble offers luxury but requires regular sealing. Matte finishes are recommended on floors for traction.
